method: manual visual transcription of the full printed phrase in each exact supplied native, usage720, and thumbnail320 file using fifteen actual view_image calls, each with detail original. Read review-protocol.md and preflight.json first; preflight images were empty. Saved and read back reviews/craft-action-first.json with unchanged empty viewed/readings arrays before opening packet.json. Then read the full request, copy, and conditions. Observed strings below preserve the visible grouping with line breaks where applicable; equal normalises whitespace only. No OCR, crops, substitute images, web, connectors, agents, other profiles, or production material were used. The viewer returned original detail and no view failed; low-contrast surface effects remain display-sensitive. PNG header dimensions were read without image alteration: all native files are 1024x1536 and usage files 720x1080, exactly 2:3; all thumbnails are 213x320, a 0.156% ratio deviation, within 1%. Pixels do not certify authorship or physical/printing performance. The supplied unchanged seven-dimension rubric and AI-slop detail were applied without additions or target scores.
